enum Key { Up, Down(i32), Stop }
enum HTTPServer2State { A, B(i32), C }
struct HTTPServer2 { __lanius_state: HTTPServer2State }
fn http_server2_start() -> HTTPServer2 { return HTTPServer2 { __lanius_state: HTTPServer2State::A }; }
impl HTTPServer2 {
    fn step(&mut self, __lanius_event: Key) -> i32 {
        return match (self.__lanius_state) {
            HTTPServer2State::A -> { return self.__lanius_in_A(__lanius_event); },
            HTTPServer2State::B(level) -> { return self.__lanius_in_B(level, __lanius_event); },
            HTTPServer2State::C -> { return self.__lanius_in_C(__lanius_event); },
        };
    }
    fn state(&self) -> HTTPServer2State { return self.__lanius_state; }
    fn __lanius_in_A(&mut self, __lanius_event: Key) -> i32 {
        return match (__lanius_event) {
            Key::Up -> { self.__lanius_state = HTTPServer2State::B(1); return 1; },
            Key::Down(by) -> { let twice: i32 = by * 2; self.__lanius_state = HTTPServer2State::B(twice); return twice; },
            Key::Stop -> { return 0; },
        };
    }
    fn __lanius_in_B(&mut self, level: i32, __lanius_event: Key) -> i32 {
        return match (__lanius_event) {
            Key::Up -> { self.__lanius_state = HTTPServer2State::B(level + 1); return level; },
            Key::Down(_) -> { self.__lanius_state = HTTPServer2State::A; return level; },
            Key::Stop -> { self.__lanius_state = HTTPServer2State::C; return 0; },
        };
    }
    fn __lanius_in_C(&mut self, __lanius_event: Key) -> i32 {
        return match (__lanius_event) {
            Key::Up -> { return 0; },
            Key::Down(_) -> { return 0; },
            Key::Stop -> { return 0; },
        };
    }
}


fn between() -> i32 { return 2; }

enum SkipState { Text, Slash }
struct Skip { __lanius_state: SkipState }
fn skip_start() -> Skip { return Skip { __lanius_state: SkipState::Text }; }
impl Skip {
    fn step(&mut self, __lanius_event: u8) {
        match (self.__lanius_state) {
            SkipState::Text -> { self.__lanius_in_Text(__lanius_event); return; },
            SkipState::Slash -> { self.__lanius_in_Slash(__lanius_event); return; },
        };
    }
    fn state(&self) -> SkipState { return self.__lanius_state; }
    fn __lanius_in_Text(&mut self, __lanius_event: u8) {
        match (__lanius_event) {
            47 -> { self.__lanius_state = SkipState::Slash; return; },
            _ -> { let c: u8 = __lanius_event; return; },
        };
    }
    fn __lanius_in_Slash(&mut self, __lanius_event: u8) {
        match (__lanius_event) {
            47 -> { self.__lanius_state = SkipState::Text; return; },
            _ -> { let _other: u8 = __lanius_event; self.__lanius_state = SkipState::Text; return; },
        };
    }
    fn run(&mut self, __lanius_events: [u8], __lanius_count: i32) {
        let __lanius_at: i32 = 0;
        while (__lanius_at < __lanius_count) {
            __lanius_at = match (self.__lanius_state) {
                SkipState::Text -> self.__lanius_run_Text(__lanius_events, __lanius_at, __lanius_count),
                SkipState::Slash -> self.__lanius_run_Slash(__lanius_events, __lanius_at, __lanius_count),
            };
        }
    }
    fn __lanius_run_Text(&mut self, __lanius_events: [u8], __lanius_from: i32, __lanius_count: i32) -> i32 {
        let __lanius_at: i32 = __lanius_from;
        while (__lanius_at < __lanius_count) {
            let __lanius_event: u8 = __lanius_events[__lanius_at];
            __lanius_at += 1;
            match (__lanius_event) {
            47 -> { self.__lanius_state = SkipState::Slash; return __lanius_at; },
            _ -> { let c: u8 = __lanius_event; continue; },
        };
        }
        self.__lanius_state = SkipState::Text;
        return __lanius_at;
    }
    fn __lanius_run_Slash(&mut self, __lanius_events: [u8], __lanius_from: i32, __lanius_count: i32) -> i32 {
        let __lanius_at: i32 = __lanius_from;
        while (__lanius_at < __lanius_count) {
            let __lanius_event: u8 = __lanius_events[__lanius_at];
            __lanius_at += 1;
            match (__lanius_event) {
            47 -> { self.__lanius_state = SkipState::Text; return __lanius_at; },
            _ -> { let _other: u8 = __lanius_event; self.__lanius_state = SkipState::Text; return __lanius_at; },
        };
        }
        self.__lanius_state = SkipState::Slash;
        return __lanius_at;
    }
}

fn main() -> i32 { return between(); }
